basic_profile.bio: Avid LEGO enthusiast and Star Wars aficionado based in Wellington, New Zealand. I spend my weekends building intricate LEGO sets and exploring the rich lore of Star Wars. When I'm not piecing together LEGO bricks, I enjoy hiking and photography. As a software developer, I have a flexible schedule, allowing me to be active online mostly in the evenings. Currently in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my passion for sci-fi. I dislike low-quality knock-offs and always appreciate a respectful online discourse.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in LEGO and Star Wars comes from years of collecting sets and reading extended universe novels. My technical knowledge in software development stems from a Computer Science degree and over a decade of professional experience.
